functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the solution meets the stated requirements and performs the correct operations without errors.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses the solution's ability to handle edge cases effectively, such as empty inputs or maximum constraints.

efficiency.description: Measures the time and space complexity of the solution, ensuring it adheres to the required performance benchmarks.

robustness.description: Determines how well the solution handles invalid inputs and unexpected scenarios without failing.

api_library_usage.description: Evaluates the proper and effective use of APIs or libraries in the solution, ensuring they are utilized appropriately.

readability_maintainability.description: Assesses the clarity and organization of the code, including naming conventions, comments, and overall structure.

error_handling_security.description: Evaluates the solution's ability to handle errors gracefully and to avoid potential security vulnerabilities.
